themes.name: Cyberpunk 2077
themes.author: ardenad, after Sebastian
themes.description: A 1920×480 dashboard for horizontal screens, built around the official Cyberpunk 2077 key art. The hero artwork fills the left panel inside a rounded frame, while the right side shows a large 24-hour clock with seconds and the current date. A top strip displays the running game and its live FPS, and three gauge cards break down CPU, GPU and RAM load with temperature, power draw, frequency and fan

themes.name: Pragmata
themes.author: ardenad, after Sebastian
themes.description: A 1920×480 dashboard for horizontal screens, featuring the Pragmata character artwork. A light, clean layout places the art in a rounded frame on the left, with a large clock, seconds and full date on the right. The header shows the active game and its FPS; three gauge cards report CPU, GPU and RAM usage alongside temperature, power, frequency and fan speed. The footer displays network download/up
